  | { scope: "platform" }

async function hasPermissionByLevel(
  supabase: ServiceClient,
  userId: string,
  level: number,
  scope?: PermissionScope,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!scope || scope.scope === "platform") {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(
      "has_platform_permission_level",
      {
        check_user_id: userId,
        required_level: level,
      },
    );

    if (error) {
      throw new ApiError(
        500,
        "internal_error",
        "Could not verify platform permission level.",
      );
    }

    return data === true;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(
    "has_product_permission_level",
    {
      check_product_id: scope.productId,
      check_user_id: userId,
      required_level: level,
    },
  );

  if (error) {
    throw new ApiError(
      500,
      "internal_error",
      "Could not verify product permission level.",
    );
  }

  if (data === true) return true;

  const { data: platformData, error: platformError } = await supabase.rpc(
    "has_platform_permission_level",
    {
      check_user_id: userId,
      required_level: level,
    },
  );

  if (platformError) {
    throw new ApiError(
      500,
      "internal_error",
      "Could not verify platform permission level.",
    );
  }

  return platformData === true;
}

export async function hasPermissionByKey(
  supabase: ServiceClient,
  userId: string,
  key: string,
  scope?: PermissionScope,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!scope || scope.scope === "platform") {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("has_platform_permission", {
      check_user_id: userId,
      check_permission_key: key,
    });

    if (error) {
      throw new ApiError(
        500,
        "internal_error",
        "Could not verify platform permission.",
      );
    }

    return data === true;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("has_product_permission", {
    check_product_id: scope.productId,
    check_user_id: userId,
    check_permission_key: key,
  });

  if (error) {
    throw new ApiError(
      500,
      "internal_error",
      "Could not verify product permission.",
    );
  }

  return data === true;
}

export async function readJsonBody<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  req: Request,
): Promise<T> {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    throw new ApiError(405, "bad_request", "Only POST requests are supported.");
  }

  try {
    return (await req.json()) as T;
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(400, "bad_request", "Request body must be valid JSON.");
  }
}

async function resolveProduct(
  supabase: ClassKitServiceClient,
  productKey: string | undefined,
  origin: string,
) {
  const resolvedProductKey = resolveProductKeyHint(productKey, origin);
  const rpcName = resolvedProductKey
    ? "resolve_product_by_key_and_origin"
    : "resolve_product_by_origin";

  const rpcArgs = resolvedProductKey
    ? {
      p_product_key: resolvedProductKey,
      p_origin: origin,
    }
    : {
      p_origin: origin,
    };

  logProductContextDebug("product.resolve.start", {
    origin,
    requestProductKey: productKey ?? null,
    resolvedProductKey: resolvedProductKey ?? null,
    rpcName,
  });

  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(rpcName, rpcArgs);

  if (error) {
    throw new ApiError(
      500,
      "internal_error",
      "Could not resolve product context.",
    );
  }

  const products = (data ?? []) as ProductLookupRow[];
  logProductContextDebug("product.resolve.rpc_result", {
    origin,
    rpcName,
    matchCount: products.length,
    productKeys: products.map((product) => product.product_key),
  });

  if (!resolvedProductKey && products.length > 1) {
    throw new ApiError(
      400,
      "bad_request",
      "Product resolution is ambiguous for this origin. Set CLASS_KIT_LOCAL_PRODUCT_KEY for local development or use a unique production origin.",
    );
  }

  const product = products[0] ?? null;

  if (!product) {
    logProductContextDebug("product.resolve.no_match", {
      origin,
      requestProductKey: productKey ?? null,
      resolvedProductKey: resolvedProductKey ?? null,
    });
    throw new ApiError(
      403,
      "forbidden",
      "Product is not allowed for this origin.",
    );
  }

  const { data: policy, error: policyError } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("auth_mode,email_password_enabled,google_oauth_enabled")
    .eq("id", product.product_id)
    .single();

  if (policyError || !policy) {
    throw new ApiError(
      500,
      "internal_error",
      "Could not resolve product auth policy.",
    );
  }

  const productPolicy = policy as ProductPolicyRow;
  const matchedOrigin = await loadMatchedProductOrigin(supabase, product.product_id, origin);

  const { data: redirects, error: redirectsError } = await supabase
    .from("product_auth_redirects")
    .select("provider,environment,origin,redirect_url,is_default")
    .eq("product_id", product.product_id)
    .eq("status", "active")
    .order("is_default", { ascending: false })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

  if (redirectsError) {
    throw new ApiError(
      500,
      "internal_error",
      "Could not resolve product auth redirects.",
    );
  }

create table class_kit.permissions (
	id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
	key text not null unique,
	description text,
	scope text not null check (scope in ('platform', 'product', 'any')),
	created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table class_kit.function_permission_requirements (
	id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
	function_name text not null,
	action text not null,
	requirement_type text not null check (requirement_type in ('public', 'authenticated', 'level', 'permission_key')),
	scope text check (scope in ('platform', 'product')),
	required_level integer,
	permission_key text references class_kit.permissions(key) on delete restrict,
	notes text,
	created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	unique (function_name, action),
	check (
		(requirement_type = 'level' and scope is not null and required_level is not null and permission_key is null)
		or (requirement_type = 'permission_key' and scope is not null and required_level is null and permission_key is not null)
		or (requirement_type in ('public', 'authenticated') and required_level is null and permission_key is null)
	)
);

create table class_kit.platform_roles (
	id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
	key text not null unique,
	name text not null,
	level integer not null check (level >= 0),
	is_builtin boolean not null default false,
	is_protected boolean not null default false,
	created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table class_kit.platform_user_roles (
	user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
	role_id uuid not null references class_kit.platform_roles(id) on delete cascade,
	created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	primary key (user_id, role_id)
);

create table class_kit.platform_role_permissions (
	role_id uuid not null references class_kit.platform_roles(id) on delete cascade,
	permission_key text not null references class_kit.permissions(key) on delete restrict,
	created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	primary key (role_id, permission_key)
);

create table class_kit.product_roles (
	id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
	product_id uuid not null references class_kit.products(id) on delete cascade,
	key text not null,
	name text not null,
	level integer not null check (level >= 0),
	is_builtin boolean not null default false,
	is_protected boolean not null default false,
	created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	unique (product_id, key),
	unique (product_id, id)
);

create table class_kit.product_user_roles (
	product_id uuid not null references class_kit.products(id) on delete cascade,
	user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
	role_id uuid not null,
	status text not null default 'active' check (status in ('active', 'inactive')),
	created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
	primary key (product_id, user_id, role_id),
	foreign key (product_id, user_id) references class_kit.users(product_id, user_id) on delete cascade,
	foreign key (product_id, role_id) references class_kit.product_roles(product_id, id) on delete restrict
);

create unique index product_user_roles_one_active_role

create table class_kit.product_role_permissions (

create or replace function class_kit_private.ensure_product_builtin_roles(check_product_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = class_kit, class_kit_private, public
as $$
declare
	manager_role_id uuid;
begin
	insert into class_kit.product_roles (product_id, key, name, level, is_builtin, is_protected)
	values
		(check_product_id, 'manager', 'Manager', 75, true, true),
		(check_product_id, 'user', 'User', 10, true, true)
	on conflict (product_id, key) do update set
		name = excluded.name,
		level = excluded.level,
		is_builtin = true,
		is_protected = true;

	select id into manager_role_id
	from class_kit.product_roles
	where product_id = check_product_id and key = 'manager';

	insert into class_kit.product_role_permissions (role_id, permission_key)
	select manager_role_id, permission_key
	from (
		values
			('classes.create'),
			('product.auth_mode.update'),
			('product_roles.manage'),
			('product_role_permissions.manage'),
			('product_user_roles.manage')
	) as grants(permission_key)
	on conflict do nothing;
end;
$$;

create or replace function class_kit_private.ensure_product_builtin_roles_trigger()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = class_kit, class_kit_private, public
as $$
begin
	perform class_kit_private.ensure_product_builtin_roles(new.id);
	return new;
end;
$$;
